chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Idrees, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The purification upon the purity has ten Rewards.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing purification while already pure?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual merit of performing *taharah* (ritual purification) even when already in a state of purity, yielding ten rewards. This practice, often referred to as *taharat al-taharah*, underscores the Shia emphasis on continuous spiritual vigilance and the transformative power of ritual cleanliness in maintaining a state of readiness for divine communion, extending beyond mere legal obligation to a means of spiritual elevation.
